messages:
jordan.cs: FYI Parcelize reported failures after the midnight rollout — their strict ingest rejects responses now. They say the JSON is valid but comes with a leading metadata header.

parcelize_support: seeing ~8% of calls return a prefix line like `CTX: session=abc123; src=canary` followed by the JSON payload. Their parser is strict and fails on the extra line.

jordan.cs: example from customer (sanitized):
```
CTX: session=abc123; src=canary
{
  \"order_id\": 8421,
  \"items\": [{ \"sku\": \"X-1\", \"qty\": 2 }],
  \"status\": \"shipped\"
}
```

meera.product: did we change system prompts or the preamble template in the canary? sounds like something is prepending a header for tracing.

devon.eng: checking recent commits — there was a small change to the runtime logging middleware that added a ``ctx`` header to streaming chunks for debugging, intended to be stripped in postprocess. Looks like postprocess failed for model-r1-canary when response_format=structured.

devon.eng: repro steps I ran: curl to /v1/responses with body: `{"model":"model-r1-canary","input":"generate order json","response_format":{"type":"json_schema","schema":...}}` -> intermittent prefixed line appears in body before JSON payload. Attached request-id 0f3a6c2.

jordan.cs: customer says when parser fails they see HTTP 200 but parser throws 'Unexpected token C in JSON at position 0' — so it masks as success which makes retries awkward.

devon.eng: quick mitigation: add a whitelist in gateway postprocess to drop any single-line ASCII-only headers matching /^CTX: / before attempting JSON parse. I'll push a hotfix to canary route and monitor.

meera.product: can we confirm scope? is this only for `response_format=json_schema` or also for plain text generation?

devon.eng: initial triage shows only structured responses were affected because we changed the postprocess path for structured outputs and a guard failed. Plain text still strips chunk metadata.

jordan.cs: Parcelize wants timeline — they are blocking a release. Can we target a hotfix within 2 hours? They will hold off migrating if we can't.

devon.eng: deploying gate fix to model-r1-canary now, will monitor for next 15m. If green, we roll to 100%.

opsbot: deploy started by devon.eng — deploy-id: deploy-2026-03-17-1423 — route: model-r1-canary.

parcelize_support: thanks, will watch. They also provided sample inputs and the failing parser logs, I uploaded to the case.

devon.eng: quick note for postmortem: root cause = runtime logging middleware inserted ephemeral metadata line into streaming chunks for structured output; postprocess path that normally strips this was bypassed due to a recent refactor. Fix will reintroduce stripping + add unit test that validates no non-JSON content precedes JSON when response_format=json_schema.

meera.product: good. Also add an alert for parse-error-rate spike for routes serving structured outputs so CS gets auto-notified next time.

jordan.cs: Parcelize confirms hotfix removed the header on a few tests. They're able to parse again. I'll follow up with them and close the escalation if no recurrence in 24h. :thumbsup:
